name: Wavetable Scale Stack
author: Tom Burns
description: Five scale-spaced voices over Braids Renaissance's WTx6 scan, with independent span, spread, and wavetable position.

controls.label: Span
controls.description: Sets the spacing between voices, from one scale degree up to sixteen.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Spreads the voices symmetrically, independent of the selected table position.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale whose degrees define the stack spacing.

outputs.main: Five-voice wavetable stack; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
outputs.aux: Root voice; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.

trigger: Realigns every voice so a struck stack starts the same way each time.
